r: ods-enforcerd is part of the OpenDNSSEC software. It will keep your DNS zones continuous signed. For more information, go to http://www.opendnssec.org and visit the Documentation page.

-c FILE
Read configuration from file, instead of using the default.
-d
Run daemon in foreground.
-h
Show this help.
-i
Print configuration and exit (for debugging purposes).
-v
Increase verbosity.
-V
Show version and exit.
will log all the problems via standard syslog(8).
ods-control(8), ods-enforcer(8), ods-signerd(8), ods-signer(8), ods-kasp(5), ods-kaspcheck(1), ods-timing(5), ods-hsmspeed(1), ods-hsmutil(1), opendnssec(7), http://www.opendnssec.org/
